pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Disclosure: a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls shows and hides one content region.

roles.role: none (a div controlled by the button)

aria.value: true when open, false when closed
true when disabled (the trigger stays focusable)

keyboard.action: Moves to the trigger, then into the content when it is shown.

focus: Focus stays on the trigger when toggling; hidden content is out of the tab order.
notes: The icon rotation conveys the state visually; aria-expanded conveys it to assistive technology.
Height animation respects prefers-reduced-motion and the animation 'none' setting.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
